scripts.lab:messaging: concurrently -k -n PORTAL,WIDGET,OTHER,LOG -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta "ng serve browser-integration --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4212 --allowed-hosts app.localhost" "tsx projects/browser-integration/server.ts widget" "tsx projects/browser-integration/server.ts other" "tsx projects/browser-integration/server.ts log"
scripts.lab:idor: concurrently -k -n APP,API -c cyan,magenta "ng serve idor --host localhost --port 4200" "tsx projects/idor/server/api.ts"
scripts.build: ng build xss && ng build idor && ng build site
scripts.lab:site: concurrently -k -n APP,APIS -c cyan,magenta "ng serve site --host localhost --port 4200" "tsx projects/site/server/start.ts"
scripts.experiments: concurrently -k -n APP,API -c cyan,magenta "ng serve experiments --host localhost --port 4201" "tsx watch projects/__experiments/server/index.ts"
scripts.experiment:pkce: concurrently -k -n APP,AUTH -c cyan,magenta "ng serve experiments --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4201" "tsx projects/__experiments/server/pkce.ts"
scripts.origins:generate-and-start: npm run origins:cert && npm run origins
scripts.origins: concurrently -k -n HTTPS-A,HTTPS-B,HTTP,API "ng serve experiments --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4201 --ssl --ssl-cert projects/__experiments/local-origins/certs/dev-cert.pem --ssl-key projects/__experiments/local-origins/certs/dev-key.pem --proxy-config projects/__experiments/local-origins/proxy.conf.cjs" "ng serve experiments --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4203 --ssl --ssl-cert projects/__experiments/local-origins/certs/dev-cert.pem --ssl-key projects/__experiments/local-origins/certs/dev-key.pem --proxy-config projects/__experiments/local-origins/proxy.conf.cjs" "ng serve experiments --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4202 --proxy-config projects/__experiments/local-origins/proxy.conf.cjs" "tsx projects/__experiments/local-origins/server.ts"
